unresolvedReferences.description: Xiao Yingzhou's Jingzhou post is dated only to late Jianwu (c. 498).
Ren Fang's impeachment of Xiao Yingda is undated (between 502 and 510).
Xiahou Xiang's posts under Duan Furong and Emperor Ming's favor are undated.
Qi Shizhan's discovery of the golden hook is undated (before 502).
Cai Daogong's early posts under Xiao Changmao are undated.
Li Wunu's attack on White Horse and Gongze's capture are undated (c. 479-482 by the Qi Gaodi edict).
Deng Yuanqi's early posts under Xiao Mian and Xiao Yaoxin are undated.
Deng Yuanqi's suicide in prison follows his 504 recall but the year is not stated in the chunk.
Yu Qianlou, Jiang Guangji and Liang Jinsun's roles in Yizhou (c. 503-504) are undated.
The Prince of Sui's attempt to post Deng Yuanqi in Jingzhou is undated.
Deng Yuanqi's gift of rice to a monk in his youth is undated.
